title: 微积分教学 · 调查助理 · 断桥模型
provenance: 根据历史记录复原的可练习题面；非原发布逐字重印。大作文图片为当日原图，待译句为原句。

translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

In a college calculus course, practice problems can be arranged in different ways. A conventional assignment may place similar questions together, allowing students to repeat the same procedure several times. Another arrangement mixes types of problems and returns to earlier topics after an interval. Students then need to recognize which method belongs to each question before they can begin calculating.

A study of 585 students in two existing course sections examined how such assignments related to performance. The comparison concerned ordinary teaching rather than an experiment that randomly reassigned every student. 【待译部分】Because each question no longer announced the method needed to solve it, students had to decide which approach applied, a judgment that closely resembles the demands of an exam.【待译部分结束】

The reported results suggest that mixing problems may be particularly useful for students whose earlier performance was weaker. Yet differences between existing classes should be interpreted with care: a comparison of two sections cannot by itself show that every student in every course would improve in the same way. The educational question is how to help learners choose a method when a problem does not announce its own category.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: npj Science of Learning · 2026-08-28 · Mixing problems increases performance of all students but especially of low-achieving ones in college calculus

translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

On Alaska's North Slope, researchers are asking how an Arctic ecosystem responds to a warming climate. Their work follows several connected forms of life, including birds, willow shrubs, fish, aquatic insects and beetles. A change that appears beneficial to one species may alter food, shelter or competition for another. Studying only one organism could therefore miss part of the pattern.

【待译部分】By tracing not only how each species responds to rising temperatures but also how one response changes the pressures faced by another, the project treats adaptation as a relationship rather than a solitary achievement.【待译部分结束】

The project takes place in an environment where changes can unfold at different speeds. Plants may grow under new temperature conditions while the insects and birds associated with them respond in other ways. The researchers can observe links and develop explanations, but the direction of future change remains uncertain. Their question is broader than whether one species can survive: it concerns how the relationships within an ecosystem may shift as warming continues.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: The Guardian · 2026-09-09 · Can an entire Arctic ecosystem evolve to adapt to the climate crisis?

translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

A report on a late-stage study described a possible treatment for menstrual migraine. In the study, participants were scheduled to take atogepant for seven days, beginning three days before the expected start of menstruation, across three cycles. The company reported that the treatment met the study's main goal when compared with a placebo.

【待译部分】Although the reported difference was modest, it was measured against a placebo under controlled conditions, allowing researchers to separate the treatment’s effect from changes that might have occurred simply with time.【待译部分结束】

A controlled comparison is valuable because symptoms can vary even when no active treatment is taken. Still, a reported result does not answer every practical question about who may benefit, how large the benefit is for an individual, or how the treatment should be evaluated in other settings. Further information about the study and subsequent assessment would be needed before drawing broad conclusions. The distinction between an observed difference and its wider meaning is important in reading any health report.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: Reuters · 2026-09-10 · AbbVie’s menstrual migraine treatment meets late-stage study goal

title: 历史教学 · 工作坊变更 · 物品维修
provenance: 根据历史记录复原的可练习题面；非原发布逐字重印。大作文图片为当日原图，待译句为原句。

translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

More than two decades after the attacks of September 11, 2001, American schools still face the question of how to teach this history. Requirements differ among states, and students now entering classrooms have no direct memory of that day. Teachers may use personal accounts alongside documents about events and decisions that followed.

【待译部分】Students who cannot remember the event for themselves depend on teachers to connect personal testimony with later policy debates, the significance of which may be lost when the attacks are treated as an isolated date.【待译部分结束】

A lesson organized solely around a date can provide a point of reference, yet students also need to understand why the event continues to appear in public discussion. Testimony makes history more immediate, while policy debates place it in a wider context. Selecting materials for a classroom requires care, because no single account can represent every person's experience. The challenge is to connect personal stories and historical consequences without assuming that young learners already know either one.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: Associated Press · 2026-09-08 · How every US state approaches 9/11 history in schools
translation.provenance: 背景段落复原；待译句原文

title: 黏菌 · 数字化项目 · 桥梁场景
provenance: 根据历史记录复原的可练习题面；非原发布逐字重印。大作文图片为当日原图，待译句为原句。

translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

Slime moulds have attracted attention because their behaviour can appear surprisingly flexible. In experiments, they have moved through mazes in search of food and formed networks linking separate resources. Such observations invite comparisons with problem solving, even though these organisms have no nervous system.

Some researchers argue that the behaviour challenges familiar definitions of intelligence. Others caution that a useful analogy can also obscure the biological process being studied. 【待译部分】Whether these responses amount to intelligence remains disputed, partly because the vocabulary created to describe animals with nervous systems may conceal, rather than clarify, what an organism without neurons is actually doing.【待译部分结束】

The disagreement is partly about evidence and partly about language. Describing a network as a decision may help people picture its result, but the word can imply mental processes that have not been established. Researchers must therefore ask what the experiments actually show and which terms explain those observations most accurately. Studying an organism on its own terms may reveal capabilities that familiar categories fail to capture.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: The Guardian · 2026-09-08 · “This is dangerous”: slime moulds and the bitter debate over the nature of intelligence
translation.provenance: 背景段落复原；待译句原文

translation.topic: 非洲语言学习与代际交流
translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

Young people in different places are finding new ways to learn African languages spoken by their families. A Yoruba-language program in Nigeria and online lessons in Shona connected with Zimbabwe offer two examples of this interest. For people living abroad, learning a parent's language can change how they talk with older relatives.

【待译部分】For learners raised far from their parents’ countries, mastering a heritage language can restore access to forms of family knowledge that translation conveys only imperfectly, while giving ordinary conversations with older relatives a depth they did not have before.【待译部分结束】

A language can carry family stories, ordinary expressions and ways of describing daily life that may be difficult to transfer completely into another language. Digital lessons can make learning more accessible, although a screen alone cannot replace every conversation. Questions also remain about the place of these languages in education and online content. Their continued use depends on opportunities to speak, listen and share experiences across generations.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: Associated Press · 2026-09-06 · Africa’s mother tongues are finding new life as youth connect with roots and relatives

title: 志愿者研究队列 · 校园设备借用 · 网络信息核实
provenance: 根据历史记录复原的可练习题面；非原发布逐字重印。大作文图片为当日原图，待译句为原句。

translation.topic: 英国大型志愿者研究队列
translation.text:
Directions: Read the following text carefully and translate the marked part into Chinese.

A large study in the United Kingdom analyzed baseline information from more than 1.9 million adult volunteers in the Our Future Health research program. The scale makes it possible to examine patterns of health and disease across many participants. The information includes what volunteers reported about themselves and material drawn from hospital records.

Yet the number of participants is only one question to ask about a research cohort. People who choose to volunteer may differ from people who do not, and some groups may appear in different proportions from those in the wider population. 【待译部分】A sample may be large enough to include thousands of people from a minority group and still fail to represent that group proportionally, if those who volunteer differ systematically from those who do not.【待译部分结束】

Researchers therefore need to consider both the size and the composition of the cohort when interpreting a result. A very large data set can reveal patterns while still leaving uncertainty about how those patterns apply to people who were less likely to join. Knowing the limits of a sample helps readers understand what its findings can and cannot establish.

要求：仅翻译标出的部分。
translation.source: Nature Medicine · 2026-09-10 · Phenomic profiles and disease patterns of 1.9 million participants from Our Future Health
